# Global Education Services Company (GES Quality Education)

> Leading private education group in the Sultanate of Oman, operating world-class K-12 schools, preschools, and early childhood education centers since 2012.

## Organization Identity
- **Legal Name**: Global Education Services L.L.C.
- **Brand Name**: GES Quality Education (GES®)
- **Headquarters**: Airport Heights, P.O. Box 1756, Postal Code 111, Muscat, Sultanate of Oman
- **Founding Year**: 2012
- **Founder & Chairman**: Honorable Sheikh Salim Hamood Al Hashmi
- **Official Website**: https://www.ges.om
- **Contact**: +968 24554422 | info@ges.om

## Campuses & Educational Institutions
- **Al Shomoukh International Private School (SIPS)**: Premium K-12 school in Hay Al Hail, Muscat offering the National English Curriculum (British) alongside bilingual streams.
- **Shomoukh for Early Childhood Education (Al Qurum Campus)**: Early childhood center in Shatti Al Qurum for ages 1 to 4 inspired by the Reggio Emilia approach.
- **Shomoukh for Early Childhood Education (Al Mouj Campus)**: Early learning center of excellence located in Al Mouj, Muscat.

## Operational Models
- **Private Schools**: Complete management and operation of international standard Pre-K/K-12 schools.
- **Public-Private Partnerships (PPP)**: Collaborative educational investments aligned with Oman Vision 2040.
- **Licensed Schools**: Deployment of GES operational frameworks and curricula under institutional licensing.
- **Master Franchise**: Regional educational franchising and management across the MENA region.
